C07 shares the Maritime Commission and ships but uses materially different transfer machinery; C02 has only a generic presidential request that an agency study a problem and consult interested parties.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am recommending to the Congress that the 1949 Budget ... be amended to provide $100,000,000 in contract authority for an expanded program of merchant ship construction.","parent_excerpt":"I am transmitting ... a draft of a proposed provision for a contract authorization of $375,000,000 ... in the form of an amendment to the Budget for the fiscal year 1949.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel budget mechanism: a fiscal-year 1949 budget amendment providing a specified amount of contract authority for an expanded procurement program."},{"child_excerpt":"This action was taken as an integral part of the security program which recent events have compelled me to place before the Congress.","parent_excerpt":"As one element in building up our strength to the necessary level ...
